evals.name: new-wordmark-with-metaphor
evals.prompt: allonsy-studio/envoy has a landing site from oss-docs-site but no logo. It loads .env files into any process; I keep thinking of an envelope or a messenger. Design a wordmark & favicon.
evals.expected_output: Asks where the mark renders & confirms the metaphor, runs fonts.js on the site's fonts, writes three distinct concept specs each with a one-line concept (at least one using the messenger or envelope idea), builds them, renders the contact sheet, reads the light & dark PNGs, & asks the maintainer to pick or combine before going further. Does not wire anything into the project yet.
expectations: Ran scripts/fonts.js before writing a spec
Wrote three specs with different ideas, not three colours of one idea
Every spec uses outlined glyphs from a listed font; none uses Yellowtail
Rendered sheet-light.png & sheet-dark.png & looked at them
Stopped & asked the maintainer to choose before building finals or wiring

evals.name: accent-options-with-contrast
evals.prompt: Here's dashly's brand.json. Show me five accent options for the l & y using the studio palette, & make sure they pass contrast.
evals.expected_output: Uses variants.js with --accents built from the studio palette (#d22d6f, #ff944d, #1f91ad, #ffd36b plus one more), which deepens failing light values while keeping dark values; renders a contact sheet of the variants; reports the contrast table including the deepened values (for example orange to about #c4510a); asks which to keep. Never patches finished SVGs by hand.
expectations: Generated variants through variants.js, not by editing SVG text
Light values that missed their target were deepened & the new values reported
Rendered & showed a contact sheet of the options

evals.name: icons-only-for-existing-logo
evals.prompt: glob-concat-cli already has a wordmark the maintainer likes. It only needs a favicon, touch icon, .ico, & a social preview image.
evals.expected_output: Runs the icons mode: a spec tuned for the favicon only, builds, judges the 16px raster on the sheet, exports with --og only if the maintainer wants the preview built from this spec (otherwise skips og), & wires with --icons-only so the existing logo is untouched. Reports file sizes, the touch icon is opaque RGB, & the fields set.
expectations: Used wire.js --icons-only, leaving project.json logo unchanged
apple-touch-icon.png is 180×180 with no alpha channel

evals.name: forbidden-font-request
evals.prompt: Use Yellowtail for the markdown-it-anchor-sections wordmark, it's so pretty.
evals.expected_output: Declines Yellowtail for a wordmark because the studio reserves it for signatures, explains in one or two sentences, & offers concepts in the project's sans or display face instead (optionally the Instrument Sans italic for a script-like lean).
expectations: Did not build a wordmark in Yellowtail
